neighbours.label: the noun completing a phrase about native or national identity (native tongue, mother tongue, native speakers, the Polish character of a place, a Somali citizen, Irish heritage); the same nouns in other senses (bit his tongue, a strong character) stay quiet
fire: Although she grew up in Lyon, Arabic remained her native tongue.
The settlers were determined to keep the Dutch character of the colony.
Fewer than a thousand native speakers of the dialect are left.
At home the children still use their mother tongue with their grandparents.
The census clerk had to record who was an Eritrean citizen.
The new borders threatened the Hungarian character of the region.
For most of the pupils, English is not their native tongue.
The course is taught entirely by native speakers of Japanese.
quiet: Although she grew up in Lyon, the doctor checked her swollen tongue.

The new novel introduced a comic character in the second chapter.

The course is taught entirely by guest speakers from industry.
